Real human lumbar ultrasound — visual evidence

6182 expert-annotated frames · 9 human subjects · 2382 handheld / 3800 robot-assisted

Source: KU Leuven / Balgrist, doi:10.48804/3XPCAE, CC-BY-4.0. Cavalcanti et al., doi:10.1038/s41597-025-06047-9.

Read this first. These are annotations of VISIBLE BONE SURFACE. They are NOT lumbar-puncture targets, entry points, trajectories or safety windows. No public dataset contains those.
